plan: Drive: from City of Prince George, about 179 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.7073, -122.39217, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 4.2 km on W0528 by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 10 m NW, climb about 0 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2009 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-2, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AB-deer-atv-0003.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 5-2: about 32,437 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 2.31 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.0 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
